summary.name: O'Reilly Expert Intelligence
summary.one_liner: O'Reilly's corporate landing page promoting its learning platform, Expert Intelligence AI grounding layer, and organizational training services; the page itself does not describe the "Antifragile Systems and Teams" book it was listed under.
use_cases: Grounding AI assistants in expert practitioner knowledge
Finding cited expert guidance for business decisions
Commissioning custom expert-led training for an organization
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes O'Reilly's organization-wide offerings. O'Reilly Expert Intelligence connects AI tools to O'Reilly's repository of practitioner knowledge through the O'Reilly Expert MCP, guided by job-specific agent skills. Responses are said to include direct links to supporting passages from O'Reilly experts. The O'Reilly learning platform is positioned for upskilling functions such as engineering, IT, product, marketing, finance, and leadership. Organizational training services offer custom expert-led training, and interactive workshops are available. The page also mentions a Substack newsletter called Radar and customer success stories from companies such as Tavant, DANA Indonesia, and CARTA Holdings.
notable: Expert Intelligence grounds AI tools in O'Reilly practitioner knowledge with direct citations to source passages
Expert MCP paired with job-specific agent skills
Custom organizational training and interactive workshops
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; no pricing is given
The page does not mention the Antifragile Systems and Teams book it was listed under in awesome-sre
Target audience appears to be organizations and enterprises rather than individuals
